name: sish
description_en: HTTP(S)/WS(S)/TCP tunnels to localhost using only SSH (serveo/ngrok alternative). `MIT` `Go/Docker`
description: HTTP(S)/WS(S)/TCP Tunnels to localhost using only SSH.
readme_preview:
Open source SSH tunneling for HTTP(S), WS(S), TCP, aliases, and SNI.

If you like the simplicity of serveo/ngrok-style sharing but want to use plain SSH and run your own infrastructure, `sish` is built for that.

- No custom client required for end users - Public and private tunnel workflows - Docker and binary releases - Designed for production-grade self-hosting
